consumes: recorded Grammar Glass influence carry receipts
valid replayable Code Twister cycle states
typed grammar atom ancestry and connection classes

behavior.contactMemory: Retain a bounded, explicitly decaying record of prior typed grammar-to-grammar contact without changing grammar profiles.
behavior.multiHop: Derive deterministic two-to-three-hop influence paths from recorded contact edges with explicit attenuation, loop refusal and replay digests.
behavior.laterInfluence: Convert bounded multi-hop paths into next-tick contact-memory carries that may alter later atom circulation while remaining distinct from direct interaction carries.
behavior.whyInspector: Explain the deterministic simulator derivation of a temporary composite using atom ancestry, typed relation evidence, thresholds, direct carries and exact applied memory receipts where available.
behavior.mirrorResponse: Render a concise structural response from the recorded formation and inert Draft Mirror recipe; it is not source code and is not executable.
behavior.visualAnimation: Allow a browser viewer to interpolate recorded phase/velocity and animate recorded direct and multi-hop influence paths without creating evidence.

refuses: semantic transitivity inferred from a multi-hop path
automatic draft re-entry, admission, selection or promotion
animation as proof of novelty, usefulness or correctness
